fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-flight+html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields, combining a JSON-LD NewsArticle node extracted from a Next.js React-Server-Components flight payload with the article body scraped from the rendered HTML (this CMS's JSON-LD never carries articleBody itself); latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, /articles/sitemap/1.xml) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record: S1-flight+html or S2-sitemap.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. "not_found", "http_500", "blocked_or_transient").

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the flight-payload NewsArticle JSON-LD node.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary from the JSON-LD node. Observed null on every sampled article -- this CMS does not appear to populate it.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, reconstructed from

tags inside the last div.story-content element in the HTML (JSON-LD never carries the body on this site). Can legitimately be an empty string for image-only content types (e.g. editorial cartoons under /opinion/cartoon/) that have no narrative text.

subsection.title: Subsection
subsection.description: Remaining URL path segment(s) between the section and the date-slug segment, e.g. "world", "africa", "cartoon", "football". Null when the article URL has no subsection.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: The article's URL slug (date prefix stripped).

author.title: Author
author.description: Raw author value from the JSON-LD node -- a single Person object with a @type/name pair. Passed through as-is.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date from the JSON-LD node.

image.title: Image
image.description: Raw image value from the JSON-LD node -- a list of ImageObject entries. Passed through as-is.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Is accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Paywall-metadata flag from the JSON-LD node. Only present (true/false) on premium-gated articles; absent (null) on ordinary free articles. articleBody is NOT truncated when false -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md paywall verdict.

paywallSelector.title: Paywall CSS selector
paywallSelector.description: The hasPart.cssSelector value from the JSON-LD node (e.g. ".premium-content") on premium-gated articles -- the CSS selector the site's own frontend uses to visually blur/gate the content. Null on free articles.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode sitemap item, derived from the URL slug (hyphens -> spaces, title-cased) since the plain sitemap carries no title field -- cosmetic only, not a substitute for the real headline from article mode.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the sitemap item.

date.title: Date
date.description: Publish date parsed from the URL's own YYYY-MM-DD slug prefix -- latest mode only.

lastmod.title: Last modified
lastmod.description: Date from the sitemap item's lastmod field -- latest mode only. Entries are sorted by this field, descending, since the sitemap file itself is not reliably ordered.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
